assay_run.method: Bulk RNA-seq aggregate for the 14 Figure 9a gastrocnemius specimens. Total RNA extraction with TRI reagent and 150-bp paired-end sequencing. The study-level Figshare workbooks and article do not resolve individual library or acquisition identities.

sample.biological_model: Wild-type sham-operated control in a paired unilateral denervation model
sample.biological_source: Gastrocnemius muscle from C57BL/6J mice; surgery performed at 6 months of age. Sample-specific sex not reported.
sample.sample_material: Total RNA extracted using TRI reagent from left sham-operated gastrocnemius muscle, collected 7 days after surgery. Study design: right denervation and left sham surgery in the same mouse. The native numeric suffix is a biological-replicate label; an explicit sample-to-donor mapping is not supplied. Both sexes were included; sample-specific sex and physical pooling are not specified.
